svg.title: Red Yellow Blue White and Black II
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored SVG. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Seven equal joined panels in the observed blue/red/white/black/yellow/white/blue order. Ordinary museum preview viewed; research download returned403. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red, yellow, black, blue, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/157156; inspected2026-10-27. Approximation, not a facsimile.
